name: Negotiation
description: For negotiations: offers, counters, concessions, conditions, ultimatums and time pressure.

detectors.name: Makes an offer
detectors.what: the speaker proposes specific terms or a price

detectors.name: Counter-offer
detectors.what: the speaker rejects terms and proposes different ones
detectors.example: That's too low, how about a hundred and ten?

detectors.name: Concession
detectors.what: the speaker gives something up or agrees to a request in exchange for progress
detectors.example: Fine, I can drop the setup fee.

detectors.name: Conditional offer
detectors.what: the speaker makes an offer that depends on something in return
detectors.example: If you commit to two years, I'll lower the rate.

detectors.name: Final offer
detectors.what: the speaker says this is the final offer or that there is no room to move

detectors.name: Threatens to walk away
detectors.what: the speaker says they will end the talks or leave if they do not get what they want
detectors.example: Otherwise I'll have to look elsewhere.

detectors.name: Time limit
detectors.what: the speaker sets or refers to a time limit for a decision
detectors.example: I need an answer by five.

detectors.name: Justifies a position
detectors.what: the speaker gives a reason for a price or position
detectors.example: That price reflects the extra support included.

detectors.name: Builds rapport
detectors.what: the speaker makes friendly personal conversation or a compliment to build a relationship
detectors.example: I've really enjoyed working with your team.

detectors.name: Agreement
detectors.what: the speaker agrees with or accepts what was said
detectors.example: Yes, that sounds right to me.
